verdict: Organic channels are holding the account; paid remains fully off.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, paid advertising was dark — zero spend, zero paid leads — so every measurable result came from organic search and Google Business Profile activity. Combined, your three locations drove 400 total GBP actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) in the last 28 days, with O'Hare Precision leading at 204 actions and Advance Grinding contributing 107. The standout organic signal was a 400% surge in search clicks for Forte Metals over the past 7 days, the strongest organic movement recorded in the tracking period. However, GBP engagement is softening at both Advance Grinding (down 45% week over week) and O'Hare Precision (down 8%), which we're monitoring closely heading into next period. With no paid channel active, GBP is the single engine for all three locations — a concentration we're actively working to address.
